selection_rule: Two primary MAEs are published separately. Retain nondominated outer-development methods, select minimum max(overall MAE / previous-hour overall MAE, peak MAE / previous-hour peak MAE). Within 1 percent of best score among nondominated methods prefer existing HGB, then single models, then equal and weighted ensembles. A retrospective development redesign, not an independent final-test claim. Under/over, RMSE, monthly, profile and transition errors are diagnostics. Normalization is a transparent compromise, not a measured economic cost.
